about.bodyText:

ABOUT
MONTRÉAL, CANADA

AN INDEPENDENT CREATIVE PLATFORM AT THE INTERSECTION OF FASHION, MUSIC AND IMAGE-MAKING.

FOUNDED BY ZAVYER VEGIARD, FASHIONROCKSTAR BRINGS TOGETHER CREATIVE DIRECTION, PHOTOGRAPHY, STYLING AND BEAUTY TO CREATE IMAGES FOR ARTISTS, DESIGNERS AND BRANDS.

EXPLORE THE WORK
CALL HER ANGELINA
PHOTOGRAPHY / CREATIVE DIRECTION

THE FOUNDER

ZAVYER
VEGIARD

CREATIVE DIRECTOR
PHOTOGRAPHER & STYLIST

ZAVYER VEGIARD IS A MONTRÉAL-BASED CREATIVE DIRECTOR, PHOTOGRAPHER AND STYLIST. THROUGH FASHIONROCKSTAR, ZAVYER DEVELOPS EDITORIALS, ARTIST IMAGERY, CAMPAIGNS AND RUNWAY PROJECTS.

THE WORK BEGINS WITH THE PERSON OR IDEA AT ITS CENTRE. LIGHT, SILHOUETTE, CLOTHING AND BEAUTY SHAPE THE IMAGE TOGETHER, WITH AN INTEREST IN IDENTITY, TRANSFORMATION AND UNCONVENTIONAL BEAUTY.

ALONGSIDE COMMISSIONED PROJECTS, FASHIONROCKSTAR CREATES SPACE FOR INDEPENDENT EXPERIMENTATION AND COLLABORATION WITH MONTRÉAL’S CREATIVE COMMUNITY.

THE PUBLICATION

PRINT + DIGITAL
ISSUE
01

THE PLATFORM
CONTINUES IN PRINT.

THE FASHIONROCKSTAR MAGAZINE BRINGS TOGETHER FASHION, PHOTOGRAPHY, BEAUTY AND THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE WORK. ISSUE 01 INTRODUCES THE ARTISTS, DESIGNERS, MODELS AND COLLABORATORS WHO HAVE HELPED SHAPE ITS VISUAL WORLD.
